thread:
anna.marketing: Quick sync — Q3 PLG experiment batch and launch readiness. Can we confirm seller targets + top 3 launch blockers?

carlos.sales: Heads up — sales targets we agreed: 1) 2.5k new signups from PLG funnel, 2) 450 qualified trials, 3) 90 MRR conversions. those are targets for July-Sep. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mira.gtm: Thanks. For the launch we need clear pass/fail criteria and 2 validated onboard flows. My suggested launch criteria: 
- baseline activation >= 12% at 14 days
- trial->paid conversion >= 8% for targeted segments
- no critical reliability incidents in canary (p99 latency < 350ms)

jamal_growth: +1 on those metrics. For experiments we want to run 3 variants: 1) seat-based free-tier, 2) checklist-driven onboarding (short vs long), 3) trial-extension by usage signal. Hypotheses drafted in the doc.

elaine_product: Re: blockers — product constraints to call out: private export feature (customer ask) is still on backlog (ETA > Q3). Also need a small API quota control hook for dedicated accounts (security ask). Those two could block enterprise enablement for initial launch.

anna.marketing: Can we scope a minimal workaround? e.g., export as CSV from console + manual perms? also, is quota hook doable as a config flag only in Dedicated?

elaine_product: CSV export: doable as short patch (2 sprint days) but audit logs for that export will need infra help. Quota hook: minimal server-side toggle can be added to staging in 1 sprint, prod in 2. Not ideal but viable.

carlos.sales: From field: top customers will accept manual CSV for v1 if we offer a documented SOC/controls roadmap. So that unblock is fine. The quota toggle needs to be in Dedicated for at least our first 3 customers.

mira.gtm: OK — so launch checklist for readiness meeting: 
```
- experiments ready (variants wired + tracking)
- onboarding flows instrumented
- CSV export QA'd
- quota toggle in Dedicated deployed to canary
- messaging and enablement playbook drafted
- sales training session scheduled
```

jamal_growth: Tracking plan: funnel events we need: signup, onboarding_completed, first_api_call, kv_cache_hit, trial_expired, conversion. I'll own the GTM dashboards and UTM tagging.

ops-deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary rollout for quota-toggle feature at 2026-06-05T22:00:00Z. Monitor p99 latency and error rate for 2 hours.

anna.marketing: Great. Action items: 
- Elaine: ship CSV patch + quota toggle canary (owners: @elaine_product, @eng-oncall if needed)
- Jamal: instrumentation + dashboards (owner: @jamal_growth)
- Mira: finalize playbook + enablement slide deck by 2026-05-27
- Carlos: confirm 3 pilot customers and send intros by EOD Friday

carlos.sales: On it — will DM list to @anna.marketing.

elaine_product: I'll slot the CSV work into next sprint and queue the toggle for canary. ping me if we need to bump priority.

mira.gtm: I'll queue rehearsal session with sellers the week before canary.

anna.marketing: Thanks all. We'll review blockers in next sync Tuesday. :thumbsup:
